column1: # stok scoring rules: kind <TAB> weight <TAB> phrase
# Phrases are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries; punctuation and
# hyphens count as spaces ("at-the-market" == "at the market"). A trailing '*'
# makes a prefix match ("approv*" matches approval, approved, approves).
#   cat:<catalyst>  base score for the story's catalyst (highest match wins; +5 if in headline)
#                   catalysts: fda clinical contract mna_target mna_acquirer earnings uplisting
#                              partnership product buyback crypto_ai legal_win offering
#   spec        specificity (definitive, signed, awarded...)   summed, capped at +15
#   tier1       named top-tier counterparty                   max weight applies
#   hedge       hedging language (negative weight)            summed, capped at -15
#   promo       promotional language (negative weight)        summed, capped at -15
#   nonbinding  LOI / MOU (negative weight)                   min weight applies
#   neg         negative outcome words (negative weight)      summed, capped at -30
#   spam        law-firm investor alerts etc. -> score 0
# These weights are starting guesses. Tune them against the journal
